articlesShipped.sourceChannel: RHS YouTube (@TheRHS) — channel-authority heuristic, YouTube egress blocked
articlesShipped.topicGap: Honey fungus is the most common cause of unexplained progressive hedge death in UK gardens. No existing article covered it beyond the box-blight piece. Strongly procedural (identify toadstools, bark peel test, bootlace check, removal, barrier, replant), locally specific to CT10 given old orchard/market-garden history in St Peter's and Reading Street, and chalk-soil constraints on barrier depth.
